svg.title: From Bid to Partial Sale to First Position
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-partial-sale-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: From Bid to Partial Sale to First Position; subtitle: Price it, audit it, size the partial, clean up the wrap; caption: A four-stage path for buying a note, selling a front partial and keeping the tail, built from Paperstac and Cal Ewing operating rules.; assumptions note: Week labels are an organizing frame; practitioners did not state a four-week timeline. Dollar and yield figures are their reported examples.; note: Sources: Paperstac (MkofIE1Xq0o, XRyBErGyKgQ, 5bOm5hdSRXc), Cal Ewing (LCY-eZOK6gw).; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Lock an Indicative Bid; deliverable: Bid built off verified rate, UPB, origination date and last pay date; gate: Never lowball every listing by $20,000 (Paperstac); week: Week 2; title: Clean the Collateral; deliverable: FBO wording, address and signer confirmed and screenshotted; gate: Vesting verified before collateral goes to the auditor (Paperstac); week: Week 3; title: Size and Model the Partial; deliverable: On a $400 payment, 12 months equals $4,800; paying $4,000 earns about 20% while $5,000 loses money; gate: Payoff, auction and REO splits modeled before any partial sells (Cal Ewing); week: Week 4; title: Move the Wrap to First Position; deliverable: Title run, underlying lien disclosed, partial proceeds pay it off; gate: Assignments and deeds recorded (Paperstac)
